name: Crystalvein Mine
summary: In central Stranglethorn Vale, prospectors risk the basilisks of Crystalvein Mine for its Singing Crystals. The cavern lies near the ancient ruins of Zul'Mamwe, and the creatures inside have overrun the site and turned miners to stone.

sections.title: A Lucrative Trap
sections.body:
Near Zul'Mamwe, Crystalvein Mine cuts into the jungle hills. Its Singing Crystals fetch a high price in southern trade ports, so the Venture Company came to work the valuable veins.

The mine's native basilisks have made that work perilous. They eat the strange crystals, which harden their scales and make them unnaturally lethal. Petrified trolls and humans outside the cave mouth mark the failure of the Venture Company's expeditions.

faq.answer: Crystalvein Mine holds rare Singing Crystals, a valuable mineral found only in Stranglethorn Vale. Goblins such as Crank Fizzlebub prize their sound and worth, drawing prospectors into the dangerous caverns.

faq.q: Why are there stone statues outside the mine?
faq.answer: The statues are petrified troll locals and Venture Company laborers. The basilisks feed on the resonant crystals, hardening their hides and turning intruders to stone.

faq.q: Who controls Crystalvein Mine right now?
faq.answer: The Venture Company claimed the right to exploit Crystalvein Mine, but the basilisks keep it from them. The goblins have been unable to establish active mining operations in the cavern's depths.

angles.text: If you are a miner drawn by Singing Crystals, tread carefully. The native basilisks make prospecting here one of Stranglethorn's most dangerous endeavors.
